# authwise_guard_cluster_trust_rule (Resource)

A rule of a Guard cluster trust: pods of one namespace running as one service account (or `*`, any of the namespace's) may join the network with their projected service account token. The node is named `<node_name_prefix>-<pod name>`, runs on platform `KUBERNETES`, is added to `node_group`, and counts against `max_nodes` (1 to 1000; unset is 100). `ephemeral` removes a node once it has been offline an hour, or as soon as its pod leaves: for Deployment and Job pods, not StatefulSet pods, which keep their node across restarts. Changes apply to joins from now on; joined nodes keep what they joined with. Deleting a rule stops further joins; joined nodes stay.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Argo CD's application controller pods join as ephemeral nodes of the
# cluster's group. StatefulSet pods that should keep their node across
# restarts get a rule without ephemeral.
resource "authwise_guard_cluster_trust_rule" "argocd" {
  tenant_id        = "t-01"
  network_id       = authwise_guard_network.office.guard_network_id
  cluster_trust_id = authwise_guard_cluster_trust.gfk.guard_cluster_trust_id
  namespace        = "argocd"
  service_account  = "argocd-application-controller"
  node_name_prefix = "argocd"
  ephemeral        = true
  node_group       = authwise_guard_node_group.gfk_pods.name
  max_nodes        = 10
}

# Every service account of the AWX job namespace.
resource "authwise_guard_cluster_trust_rule" "awx_jobs" {
  tenant_id        = "t-01"
  network_id       = authwise_guard_network.office.guard_network_id
  cluster_trust_id = authwise_guard_cluster_trust.gfk.guard_cluster_trust_id
  namespace        = "awx-jobs"
  service_account  = "*"
  node_name_prefix = "awx"
  ephemeral        = true
  node_group       = authwise_guard_node_group.gfk_pods.name
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_trust_id` (String) The cluster trust's id, `authwise_guard_cluster_trust.<name>.guard_cluster_trust_id`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `namespace` (String)
- `network_id` (String) The network's id, `authwise_guard_network.<name>.guard_network_id`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `service_account` (String)
- `tenant_id` (String) The kit tenant's id (`t-…`) the Guard row belongs to. Guard has no tenant of its own since the tenant collapse (tf#65). The provider's `tenant_id` is not used. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `ephemeral` (Boolean)
- `max_nodes` (Number)
- `node_group` (String)
- `node_name_prefix` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) `created_at` as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `created_by` (String)
- `guard_cluster_trust_rule_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `name` (String) Full resource name; serves as the Terraform ID.
- `node_count` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the rule's full name.
terraform import authwise_guard_cluster_trust_rule.argocd tenants/t-01/networks/n-01/clusterTrusts/ct-01/rules/ctr-01
```
